skirmish.module.tool_saver.name: Tool Saver
skirmish.module.tool_saver.description: Keeps an almost broken tool alive: a pickaxe, axe or shovel under the threshold stops mining (optionally a weapon stops hitting). Press again right away to use it anyway. A pill warns beforehand.
skirmish.module.tool_saver.setting.thres: Uses left at which the tool stops working
skirmish.module.tool_saver.setting.weapo: Don't hit players and mobs with an almost broken sword or axe (careful in fights)
skirmish.module.tool_saver.setting.warn_: The pill appears below this durability percentage
skirmish.module.tool_saver.setting.sound: A short sound when a hit is held back
skirmish.tool_saver.blocked: %s: %s uses left — press again to use it anyway
